identity: The guild of cupola tenders, pattern makers, and stokers who keep the valley's iron flowing. Their furnace floor is the backbone of winter: without their heat, the cold takes the valley in forty-eight hours. They are exact, proud, and internally divided — production against safety, master engineers against apprentices, treaty quotas against local autonomy.

relationships.notes: Sulfur and acid for forged pickaxes and acid-resistant lead-antimony pipes (treaty_05).
Coal and ore from the drifts; foundry shifts capped during liquid iron pours (treaty_10).
Labor and milk support, shift oversight, and the constitution's labor articles (treaty_10, treaty_16).
Narrow-gauge rail system; spike and wheel quotas, coal gondolas, right-of-way (treaty_12).
Water-flow and turbine components; the foundry's water demand is metered against the hydro lines.
The Standing Record logs foundry output, incidents, and labor disputes.
Treats foundry injuries; the healers' burn ward knows the furnace floor by name.
The Flotilla trades scavenged metal; the Foundry refuses to melt wreckage taken from contested wrecks.
